title: Session browsing omits collected native transcripts because it reads daemon-local metadata
wanted_capability: Browse retained native Claude Code and Codex sessions by recency with project/account filters and bounded pagination, without requiring producer filesystem roots on the corpus daemon.
missing_primitive: A corpus-owned session summary enumeration consumed by bbox_sessions_list. The current implementation only reads local Claude usage-data/session-meta and Codex session files.
fallback_used: Use bbox_search to discover native locators and exact session ids, then bbox_session for indexed metadata and source freshness.
evidence: 2026-09-10 live bbox_sessions_list(limit=3) returned No sessions found while bbox_search returned native user messages timestamped the same day.
2026-09-10 live bbox_session reported completed producer scan at 17:45:47 UTC: 756 discovered, zero failed/deferred, sampled indexed generations matched published generations.
notes: Distinct from addressed gap-e40feb8f (native ingestion) and addressed gap-72fd5932 (project-filter matching). The tool description acknowledges metadata-only coverage but ordinary recency browsing remains unavailable for collected sessions. Preserve source/account identity, generation deduplication, and indexed-projection limitations.
resolution_note: Implemented and pushed in 09c4f31f: retained-index session catalog with source/account/project/exclusion filters, stable timestamp ordering, generation-aware cache, bounded pagination, and explicit unavailable name metadata. Full workspace verification passed 6743 tests (19 suite skips), with an unrelated three-second publication-lock test scheduled alone after load-sensitive timeouts; formatting, Clippy and concurrency lint passed. Deployed to cage with operator approval on 2026-09-10: image 09c4f31f860c, digest sha256:9ec9adb2cf8ce27fed6c562994e33e17ddeb3214e39130a2098b545e90bac62d, overlay commit 1633d6c. Pulumi updated only blackboxd Deployment, rollout succeeded with 1/1 ready. Live bbox_sessions_list returned 2381 indexed sessions; pagination, exclusion, project and source/account filters passed, including all nine added Claude accounts. Exact native session read matched its published generation after deployment. Host collection now covers all eleven intended roots: 1785 streams, 1029 newly covered streams, completed background scans with zero failed/deferred; historical/recent samples and account searches verified for every added account. The first scheduled post-deployment scan completed at 2026-09-10T18:21:20Z with 1786 streams discovered, zero failed/deferred, and the sampled native generation still matching its published source.
